# coderforge_storage (Data Source)

Look up a disk by id or by name, to attach an existing one to a container service or to read where it is attached.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Resource id, for example `store:0003`. Specify this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Disk name. Specify this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `attached_to` (String) Machine the disk is attached to, if any.
- `created_at` (String)
- `managed_by` (String) Owning resource, if any.
- `path` (String) Image path on the hypervisor host.
- `port` (Number) SATA port, when attached.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in GiB.
